name: How long do interior finish upgrades take?

mainEntity.name: How long do interior finish upgrades take?

acceptedAnswer.text: The timeline for interior finish upgrades depends on the project's complexity and size. Minor upgrades, such as painting or installing new light fixtures, might take a few days. More extensive projects, like a full kitchen or bathroom renovation with custom finishes, can take several weeks to a few months, including design, material selection, and installation. We work to establish realistic timelines and keep you informed throughout the process for your project in areas like Berkeley, Oakland, and the East Bay.
acceptedAnswer.description: Project timelines vary; minor upgrades take days, while extensive renovations can take several weeks to months. We provide clear timelines.
